admission.justification: The direct store retention test keeps a live record while pruning settled records; the rule prevents losing the identity required to reconcile an in-flight session.

applicability: Presenter attempt retention performed by the durable attempt store.
conditions: Retention examines a record in started or running state.
exclusions: Settled attempts beyond the retained window, which may be reclaimed.
statement: Presenter retention must not remove an attempt whose current state is started or running.
